description.value: Claudio's Ristorante is an Italian restaurant in Burnaby's Solo District development, serving housemade fresh pasta, wood-fired-style pizzas, and a full bar with happy hour offerings. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating and caters to private events from intimate dinners to full restaurant buyouts. Cyclists passing through the Brentwood area will find a range of vegetarian-friendly dishes and online ordering for takeout.
